TEXT: And on the day of the date--

I sighed when I felt the unprecedented attention 
that we attracted.
Of course, the reason is standing right next to me--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Is something the matter, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, it's nothing.

People walking down the streets are all turning to 
catch a glimpse of Ayase. Well, with such a cute 
girl around, it's natural we'd attract attention.

Being able to call her my girlfriend makes me feel 
so proud. Still...

I hadn't expected to come to Akihabara with 
Ayase ever again.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: So, where should we start off?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You seem pretty motivated today.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
That's because I've put a lot of effort into 
preparing for today.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
If it's about Meruru, I've read up on it. The anime's 
third season starts airing soon. Kanako said so as 
well.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
And then there was Mas...chera? Or something? 
There are still many enthusiastic fans who haven't 
given up on a second season yet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay, I get it. That's enough.

Something about her reciting all of her otaku 
knowledge in that monotone voice frightens me.
But it seems like she really did study up on it.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hm... Okay then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, let's just start with something that's closeby.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes. I'll leave it to you then, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I noticed this the last time we were here, but there 
are a lot of people in different costumes around 
here.

That's what Ayase thought as we stepped onto 
Akiba's central street for the first time in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, that's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
And there seems to be more maids around than 
last time, for some reason.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, that's just to attract potential customers.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Eh? But if it's just for a cafe, wouldn't this be too 
many people?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
These days, there are maids in all sorts of 
businesses.

I've heard they employ maids in more than just 
cafes lately. From bars to ear picking, there are all 
kinds of services now.

After giving her an explanation, Ayase's expression 
stiffened a bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: O-Onii-san, you seem to know a lot about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, not really.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[font_size=28]You do![/font_size] Y-You haven't gone to some shop 
to have your ears picked, have you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Never. Besides, if I wanted someone to pick my 
ears, I'd rather have it done by you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
G-[font_size=22]Geez[/font_size][font_size=21],[/font_size] [font_size=21]Onii-san[/font_size][font_size=20].[/font_size] [font_size=20]You[/font_size] [font_size=19]keep[/font_size] [font_size=19]asking[/font_size] [font_size=18]these[/font_size] [font_size=15]embarrassing[/font_size] 
[font_size=13]things...[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No go?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Well, that's...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Geez, no matter what you say, that won't happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Should've known, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: That's right. I'm a serious girl.

Serious, huh. True, Ayase's way of thinking is best 
described as straightforward and level-headed.
And she's quite a stickler for the rules.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
But more importantly, where did all that knowledge 
come from? You didn't seem to know this much 
the last time we came.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I heard a lot from some people who come to 
Akiba quite often.

As I said that, I took out a piece of paper that 
Ayase immediately showed great interest in.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
That's an incredibly detailed map. I don't think we'll 
be able to visit all the places in just one day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, once I said I wanted to bring my girlfriend to 
Akiba, she went to great lengths to make me this 
map.

From places aimed at the general public to the 
more specialised stores, everything was thoroughly 
described.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I gotta hand it to Saori.

I expressed my thanks to the creator of the map 
and turned to face Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
So first up... Let's go check out some doujinshi, shall 
we?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Doujinshi... You mean that stuff they sold at 
Comiket?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. The major circles tend to sell their goods 
through consignment.

I taught Ayase all I knew about Akihabara as we 
were walking to our first stop.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
No matter how many times I see it, this place is 
really intense.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

I've gotten used to it thanks to Kirino and the 
others, but like Ayase said, it really is an intense 
environment.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, isn't this a Meruru doujinshi?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Looks like it.

Seeing Ayase like this, I unintentionally breathed a 
sigh of relief.
Seems like her tolerance is pretty high today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
If it continues like this, the day she comes to accept 
Kirino's hobbies might not be so far away.

Afterwards, we went to some other book and 
game shops. Then we decided for a change of 
pace and went into a different store.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...This is amazing. It looks almost like the real thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: E-Err, Ayase-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
What's the matter, Onii-san? Stop hiding in the 
corner and come here.

No, Ayase. I'm sorry but even I wouldn't dare 
approach you right now.
Or rather...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Strange. [font_size=28]I think I'm taking a fancy to this 
store...[/font_size]

It could be my imagination, but I think I felt 
something ominous in Ayase's eyes as she was 
caressing the edged tool.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey, Ayase. Isn't it about time we left?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Is that so? Still, just a bit longer...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
No, sorry, but I'm getting pretty hungry! Let's go 
eat something!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah...

I grabbed the reluctant Ayase and rushed out of 
the store.

I'm definitely never bringing Ayase to a store like 
this again.
No, seriously.
